snippet.title: UNITRES Dreams - Developer Playthrough
snippet.description:
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/project/1581465
https://unlimited-trees.itch.io/unitres-dreams
play the game ehehehehe !!

i finally have a computer strong enough to record a whole playthrough of this game so i felt its about time i showed my own gameplay of this. some levels still run a little slow.. but at least its watchable i think hehe. i wanted to show off some of the secrets while also keeping some things secret... i also skip most of the dialogue cus most of it im not really proud of and i think its best u experience it urself.

anyways. UNITRES Dreams is the game i made. it is like a 2d platformer but strange. it is on newgrounds and itch.io for free. play it. ehehehee.

i only show the main campaign and original campaign but there is still a lot more to this game... maybe i will record more videos of it later ehehehe.
